description: This file defines the ViewBackups class for the SuiteCRM administration module, responsible for handling backup operations such as directory validation, backup creation, and displaying backup status within the admin interface.

classes.name: ViewBackups
classes.description: A class that manages the backup view in the SuiteCRM administration panel, including security checks, backup process initiation, and user interface rendering.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of HTML links and strings to set the module page title in the admin interface.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control checks to ensure only authorized admin users can access backup functionalities.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the backup process, including validation of input parameters, directory and file management, and generating the backup ZIP archive.
